sentences.text: If you dig a pit for your toilet pipe, you have a septic tank.
But it fills with raw sewage that spills onto the lawn.
So you build a concrete tank, often around 1,000 gallons, and solids sink.
But now fats, oil and grease float to the top as scum.
So a T-shaped pipe below the scum lets only clear water out.
But now that pipe dumps it in one spot, and the lawn floods.
So holed pipes in gravel spread it, and the soil soaks it up.
Sludge still builds, so it is pumped every 3 to 5 years.
Add a riser lid and the grass back on top.
Congratulations, you have built a septic tank.
